apprentice
音标：英 /ə'prentɪs/  美 /ə'prɛntɪs/
n. 学徒

例句：The apprentice lingered his work.
这个徒弟磨洋工。
例句：His apprentice always leaves the tools about.
他的徒弟老是乱放工具。
例句：That would be good for my apprentice to have, complementary.
补充说一下，那会是成为我徒弟的优势。

grandma
